seed_rule: first seed in 400..499 with episode-level DiD CI excluding 0 and covering the sample truth, and daily-extract same-day-share DiD |est| < 2 pp with CI including 0
dgp: 40,000 members in 60 practices (30 program, launch 2025-07-01); routine PCP 3/yr, specialist 1/yr, other 1.5/yr, ED ~0.26/yr; dedicated follow-up prob p0 by practice (program practices 5 pp lower at baseline), +2 pp common post trend; program adds +8 pp dedicated follow-up for post-launch ED visits, arriving 3-14 days later; 15% of baseline follow-ups are same-day
estimand: DiD effect of the program on the 14-day ED-to-PCP follow-up rate (ED visits in 2025; any PCP claim by the same member 0-14 days after), in percentage points
true_value_note: sample truth = mean over program-practice post-launch ED visits of (observed follow-up - follow-up with program-induced PCP visits removed); below 8 because some induced visits land where a routine PCP visit already falls in the window
